title: Bashkir — Russian passport (ICAO/MVD) with Bashkir letters
authority: MVD Russia Order No. 996 (2019) / ICAO Doc 9303 for the Russian letters; Bashkir letters by fallback
description: Russian international-passport transliteration (ICAO Doc 9303 / MVD) extended to the Bashkir letters: Ә→A, Ө→O, Ү→U, Ғ→G, Ҡ→K, Ҙ→Z, Ҫ→S, Ң→N, Һ→H (Рәдий Хәбиров → Radii Khabirov).
notes: Holders are Russian citizens: their passports carry Russian-form Cyrillic names romanized with the MVD/ICAO table (ru_icao), which has no entries for the national letters. The extra mappings here are fallbacks for input in native spelling; the real passport form depends on how the name was Russified.

Russian-form equivalents behind the fallbacks: Ғ→Г, Ҡ→К, Ҙ→З, Ҫ→С, Ә→А/Я/Э, Ө→О/У, Ү→У/Ю, Һ→Х. Native spellings can differ in vowels too (Мостай → Мустай, Салауат → Салават), which no letter table can recover.
Ғ→G is the one Turkic letter ICAO §6.B lists. ICAO Doc 9303 §6.B prints Һ as C, apparently an error; Һ→H is used, as in every national and PCGN table.
